# Ecuador Abierto
Open data about Ecuador, organized in modules. Independent project, not an official source.

- MCP endpoint: https://ecuadorabierto.com/mcp
- Transport: stateless Streamable HTTP, no authentication, read-only.
- Documentation: https://ecuadorabierto.com/developers

## Module: compras (public procurement awards from SERCOP)
- Website: https://ecuadorabierto.com/compras/
- Metadata: https://ecuadorabierto.com/api/compras/meta
- Tools: compras_get_dataset_info, compras_search_entities (query, kind, province, limit, offset), compras_get_entity (ruc), compras_list_provinces (local_only).
- Resource: ecuador-abierto://compras/dataset/info

Check metadata for coverage and generation date. Data is a static snapshot of awards, not live data, actual payments or total budgets. Province is inferred from buyer RUC and may reflect historical boundaries/headquarters. Signals are not evidence of wrongdoing. Supplier identifiers are omitted. Cite SERCOP and CC BY 3.0 EC.
